non_equivalent_observations.scope: distinct January–June 2026 survey and ever-used-YouTube question
2023–24 broad online OR television religious service question, no platform

forbidden_inferences: 23% monthly online/TV religious services is not 23% watching on YouTube.
Viewing services can occur on linear television, congregational sites, broadcast apps, other web platforms or YouTube; no service-specific denominator is supplied.
The 2023–24 worship survey is not a joint sample with Pew's January–June 2026 general YouTube ever-use estimate; multiplication or subtraction across the two does not yield a valid cross-tab.
An individual's religion, community membership or other sensitive traits cannot be inferred from video metadata, comments or content viewed.
2025 published survey results describe the 2023–24 fieldwork period, not 2025 or 2026 platform traffic.
Comparison with historical Pew religious attendance surveys requires accounting for survey mode and question wording changes.
